description_en: You can call the ModifyAuditLogConfig operation to modify the audit log settings
description_zh: 调用ModifyAuditLogConfig接口修改审计日志设置
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-audit-log-config --db-cluster-id am-t4nj8619bz2w30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --audit-log-status on --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAuditLogConfig

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to view available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，您可通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the SQL audit feature. Valid values:

on: Enable SQL audit.

off: Disable SQL audit
parameters.help_zh:
SQL审计的开启状态。取值说明：
on：开启SQL审计。
off：关闭SQL审计
parameters.name: audit_log_status

UpdateSucceed.description_en:
Indicates whether the status of the SQL audit feature is updated. Valid values:

true: The status is updated.

false: The status failed to be updated
UpdateSucceed.description_zh:
是否已更新SQL审计的开启状态。取值说明：
true：状态已更新。
false：状态更新失败
